event-runoff-ratios: Scatter plot for the Siletz River, 32 rain events: event runoff coefficient against rain over the previous 7 days. Coefficients range from about 0 to about 1.5. A dashed line marks the median coefficient of 0.493, and the one event whose window includes an estimated-flow day is drawn as a hollow square.
column-hillslope: Three panels. Left: for the synthetic column with the default storm of 25 millimetres per hour for 2 hours, the constant rain rate, the infiltration capacity falling from above the rain rate to about 17 millimetres per hour, and the water entering the soil; after ponding at 48 minutes the gap is hatched runoff. Middle: cumulative stored water and infiltration-excess runoff stacking to 50 millimetres below the 60 millimetre deficit line. Right: 20 synthetic hillslope columns for a 30 millimetre storm; the deficit falls from 80 millimetres at the ridge to 4 at the stream, and the last 10 columns, marked S, are full and shed saturation-excess runoff on top of the stored water.
